desc:
🐾 CALL A PET 🐾

Sneak into the wild, steal eggs from guarded nests, and hatch your dream pets!

🥚 STEAL & HATCH
Grab eggs from 5 zones: Forest, Savannah, Desert, Snow and Volcano. Beware of the bosses guarding them. Carry the egg back to your safe zone and hatch it.

💰 EARN CASH
Every pet you place earns money for you, even while you explore.

🐎 RIDE YOUR PETS
Call your pet and ride it across the map. Run faster, jump higher, and train on treadmills to boost your speed.

✨ RARE FINDS
Hatch Golden and Rainbow pets with huge income bonuses, and hunt the legendary Secret pets: Cerberus, Anubis and Yeti!

📖 FILL THE INDEX
Discover every pet in a zone to unlock a permanent income boost.

🎁 DAILY REWARDS
Log in every day for free cash and eggs!

Watch out for the night and the bosses, and don't get caught carrying an egg!

👍 Like & ⭐ Favorite to support the game!
